name: CHIPS direct funding agreement with Bosch for Roseville silicon-carbide production
known_limitations: The agreement supports a planned modernization and reports sample production, while commercial production was expected in 2026. It does not establish the commercial line's commissioning, accepted output, yield, utilization, or realized employment.
source_owner: National Institute of Standards and Technology
automation_notes: Track sample production, commercial production, commissioning, and accepted output as separate dated stages.
factual_nucleus: Commerce signed a direct-funding agreement for up to $225 million supporting Bosch's $2 billion Roseville silicon-carbide facility transformation. The release says sample production had begun and commercial production was expected in 2026.
